history.think: The width of the body (P1) is 0.71m, but the width of the door (P0) is currently 0.99m. Since the door is meant to cover the front of the body flush, it should have the same width as the body. The mathematical maximum bounding box width of a 0.71m wide and 0.18m deep door under any rotation is ~0.73m, which means the current width of 0.99m cannot be due to a rotation. Furthermore, the right edge of the door (hinge side) is flush with the body, while the left side sticks out significantly, indicating a scaling error along the X-axis. To fix this, I need to scale P0 along the X-axis by a factor of 0.71 / 0.99 ≈ 0.717.
The previous simulation scaling the door's X-axis by 0.717 returned ALL PASS, meaning the door now fits perfectly and operates without collisions. I will commit this fix.
